title: Blemishes Remover
about: Apply basic local smoothing to small blemishes using the browser canvas workspace. It is a simple retouching aid, not AI content-aware healing.
steps: Choose a supported image and wait for the preview.
Use the available brush or smoothing controls to target a small blemish.
Apply the adjustment in small increments to preserve natural texture.
Inspect the result at full size and undo or reduce the effect if edges look artificial.
Export the retouched image when satisfied.
capabilities: The tool provides local canvas pixel processing for basic smoothing on selected image areas, depending on the controls in the workspace.
benefits: This workflow can make blemishes remover tasks more direct by keeping the relevant controls in one browser workspace. Review the exported result before using it in another application or service.
limitations: This is not an AI healing or object reconstruction system. Strong smoothing can remove texture or create visible artifacts. Work on a copy and review at full size.

faqs.question: What does Blemishes Remover do?
faqs.answer: Apply basic local smoothing to small blemishes using the browser canvas workspace. It is a simple retouching aid, not AI content-aware healing.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my image?
faqs.answer: The registered method for this tool is browser-based. Check the current privacy notice and the visible workspace behavior before using sensitive files.

faqs.question: How can I check the result?
faqs.answer: Review the preview and open the downloaded file in its intended destination. For dimensions or metadata, use a suitable image properties or metadata viewer.
